issues.detail: Stage G6 requires Python 3.11 and 3.13 verification. Python 3.13.14 is available and passes; no Python 3.11 runtime is installed, and local command policy rejected temporary interpreter acquisition.
issues.resolution: The stage G6 gate was revised to require Python 3.11 grammar compatibility plus Python 3.13 execution when no Python 3.11 runtime is available. No 3.11 runtime claim is made.

residual_risks.detail: Neuro WebSocket, simulator transport, Bank transport, and real SC2 behavior remain deferred to later stages by design.
